narr: Typical summertime showers and thunderstorms produced isolated wind damage and heavy rainfall over the metro Atlanta area on June 27th, with the highest amounts over Atlanta proper and lower amounts stretching east and west along Interstate 20. In DeKalb county, radar estimates indicate that upwards of 3 inches of rain over the area, causing flooding over a portion of Interstate 20 and causing nearby rivers to respond.
ev: Broadcast Media reported flash flooding on Interstate 20 near the Flat Shoals Road exit. The flash flooding was a combination of heavy rainfall ranging from 2.5 to 4 inches, poor drainage, and rises on nearby Doolittle Creek. Additionally, nearby Intrenchment Creek at Constitution Road (USGS 02203700, NWS INTG1) rose to flood stage.
lsr: WATER UP TO CAR DOORS ACROSS I-20 NEAR THE FLAT SHOALS RD EXIT.
